name: nudibranch-assets
description: Only used to rebuild the files in static/css and static/vendor. The app itself doesn't need Node.

scripts.build: npm run css && npm run vendor
scripts.vendor: mkdir -p static/vendor && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/vendor/ && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js static/vendor/ && sed -i '/sourceMappingURL=/d' static/vendor/chart.umd.js
